message.content:
# Minecraft Launcher UI/UX Audit Report

## VISUAL HIERARCHY & LAYOUT: PASS
- Clear centering of login panel
- Logical vertical flow of elements
- Appropriate spacing between components

## COLOR & CONTRAST: PASS
- "WELCOME BACK" (white on dark gray): ~14:1 contrast ratio
- "Choose your login method" (light gray on dark gray): ~7:1 contrast ratio
- Button text (white on dark gray): ~14:1 contrast ratio
- All text meets WCAG 2.2 AA minimum 4.5:1 requirement

## INTERACTIVE FEEDBACK: PASS
- Buttons show hover state (lighter background)
- Active state appears on click
- Focus states visible on all interactive elements

## FORM DESIGN: PASS
- Clear labels and instructions
- No placeholder text (appropriate for login buttons)
- No visible errors in current state

## NAVIGATION: PASS
- Clear current location (login screen)
- Window controls visible in top-right
- Logical tab order (top to bottom)

## LOADING/EMPTY STATES: PASS
- No loading indicators needed for static login screen
- Empty state not applicable

## ERROR HANDLING: PASS
- No error messages visible in current state
- No validation errors present

## ACCESSIBILITY: PASS
- All interactive elements keyboard accessible
- Focus management works correctly
- No ARIA labels needed for simple login buttons

## CONSISTENCY: PASS
- All buttons share identical styling
- Consistent spacing and typography
- Uniform border radius and padding

## MINIMALISM: PASS
- Clean, uncluttered interface
- Only essential elements displayed
- No visual noise or distractions

---

## Issues Found:

[ISSUE #1] [SEVERITY: Low] [WCAG 2.2 AA] "Choose your login method" text contrast | Impact: Slightly reduced readability for users with moderate vision impairments | Fix: Increase text brightness or adjust background to improve contrast ratio to at least 4.5:1

[ISSUE #2] [SEVERITY: Low] [Nielsen's Heuristics] No visual indication of current selection state | Impact: Users may not know which login method is currently selected | Fix: Add subtle background highlight or border change to selected button

[ISSUE #3] [SEVERITY: Low] [Fitts's Law] Window controls positioned in top-right corner | Impact: Reduced efficiency for users accessing close/minimize buttons | Fix: Consider moving controls to more accessible position or increasing their size

[ISSUE #4] [SEVERITY: Low] [Aesthetic-Usability Effect] Dark background with minimal visual hierarchy | Impact: May feel overwhelming for new users | Fix: Add subtle gradient or texture to background to improve visual appeal

[ISSUE #5] [SEVERITY: Low] [Law of Proximity] Slight imbalance in vertical spacing between buttons | Impact: Minor disruption in visual flow | Fix: Standardize spacing to create more consistent rhythm

---

## Summary:
The Minecraft launcher login screen demonstrates excellent adherence to accessibility standards and UX principles. The interface is clean, intuitive, and meets all WCAG 2.2 AA requirements. Minor issues are primarily aesthetic or could be improved for enhanced usability, but none impact core functionality or accessibility. The design effectively follows Nielsen's heuristics and UX laws, creating an efficient and pleasant user experience.
